value: Participants stood midway between two left/right 8-speaker arrays, each 50 cm from midline, spanning 100 cm front to 100 cm back. Sounds were perceived centrally; Exp. 1 used front-space approach and Exp. 2 back-space approach.

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.
task_family: chest tactile PPS with looming sound

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.
task_family: chest tactile PPS with looming sound

evidence_note: No variable ITI/jitter distribution is reported beyond the fixed cycle.

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.
task_family: chest tactile PPS with looming sound

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.

title: Peripersonal space as the space of the bodily self.
